title: Butter Burger with Onion and Garlic Butter
description: Have You Tried this Butter Burger? It's My New Favorite! 🍔🧈😋
steps: Cook the whole onion until stewed.
Form the burger patties using 3-ounce portions, smash slightly with parchment paper.
Heat a skillet and add butter to it.
Cook the patties in the skillet, seasoning with salt and pepper, until caramelized.
Flip the patties and add cheddar cheese on top.
Add garlic butter to the skillet, including the chopped garlic and parsley, and cook gently to prevent burning.
Toast the buns in the garlic butter.
Assemble the burger by placing a patty on the bun, then adding the stewed onion, and topping with more garlic butter.
Serve and enjoy this delicious Butter Burger.
notes:
Use 80-20 ground beef or chuck roast for best flavor. Bacon is optional but adds richness.
